title: Consecutive Degree Clauses with olyannyira ..., hogy... and annyira ..., hogy...

sections.title: The Degree Correlative olyannyira / annyira
sections.content: In Hungarian complex sentences, intense degree followed by an inevitable consequence or resulting situation is expressed by the correlative pair 'olyannyira ..., hogy...' or 'annyira ..., hogy...' (so much ..., that...). The main clause contains the degree adverb modifying an adjective, verb, or adverb, while 'hogy' introduces the consecutive subordinate clause.

sections.title: Word Order and Stylistic Elevation in B2 Hungarian
sections.content: 'Olyannyira' carries an elevated, formal stylistic tone appropriate for history, sports analysis, and academic biography, whereas 'annyira' is universal across both spoken and written registers. When the focus falls on extreme conditions, the adverb typically stands right before the predicate: 'A víz olyannyira hideg volt, hogy...' (The water was so cold that...).

sections.title: Consecutive Degree Clauses
rows: A víz olyannyira hideg volt, hogy alig bírták a tempót.
The water was so cold that they could barely maintain the pace.
Annyira gyorsan úszott, hogy senki sem tudta utolérni.
He swam so fast that nobody was able to catch up with him.
A teljesítmény olyannyira lenyűgöző volt, hogy mindenki felállt.
The performance was so impressive that everyone stood up.

items.spanish: A verseny körülményei olyannyira mostohák voltak, hogy a sportolók az életükért küzdöttek a hullámok között.
items.english: The conditions of the race were so harsh that the athletes fought for their lives among the waves.

items.spanish: Hajós Alfréd olyannyira elkötelezett volt a hazája iránt, hogy a sport mellett sikeres építészi karriert épített.
items.english: Alfréd Hajós was so dedicated to his homeland that alongside sports he built a successful architectural career.

items.spanish: A közönség annyira lelkesen buzdította a bajnokot, hogy a kiáltások betöltötték az egész öblöt.
items.english: The crowd cheered the champion so enthusiastically that the shouts filled the entire bay.

sections.title: B2 Usage Notice
sections.content: Distinguish consecutive clauses ('olyannyira ..., hogy...' - result actually happened) from purpose clauses ('azért ..., hogy...' - intended goal). Consecutive clauses describe factual results of extreme intensity.
